title: Pure Exodia
summary: The five Forbidden One pieces paired with the Millennium engine and Exodia control Spells and Traps, plus generic staples. Rather than stalling solely to draw all five pieces, Millennium Ankh reveals them from your hand, Deck, or field to summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate for Spell/Trap negation and End Phase board wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Shield of the Millennium Dynasty places itself in the Spell & Trap Zone from the hand, pays 2000 LP (or reveals Millennium Ankh) to Special Summon itself, and searches Millennium Ankh directly from the Deck.

Sengenjin Wakes from a Millennium places itself in the Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summons itself, and searches any Millennium monster (such as Shield of the Millennium Dynasty or Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasures).

Wedju Temple places a Millennium monster from your Deck in the Spell & Trap Zone by placing a monster from your hand there, and Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasures searches Wedju Temple while preventing Millennium Ankh's activation from being negated.

summary.title: Opening: Sengenjin (or Shield) -> The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate
steps: Place Sengenjin Wakes from a Millennium in the Spell & Trap Zone, pay 2000 LP to Special Summon it, and search Shield of the Millennium Dynasty.
Place Shield of the Millennium Dynasty in the Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summon it, and add Millennium Ankh from your Deck to your hand.

Activate Millennium Ankh: reveal the five Forbidden One pieces (Exodia the Forbidden One and the four limbs) from your hand, Deck, and/or field to Special Summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate from the Extra Deck, shuffling other non-Millennium / non-Level 10 Exodia monsters back into the Deck.
During the End Phase, use The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate's effect to Set Exxod Fires of Rage or Obliterate!!! directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Alternate Win Condition & Piece Recovery
summary.text: All five Forbidden One pieces—Exodia the Forbidden One, Left Arm of the Forbidden One, Right Arm of the Forbidden One, Left Leg of the Forbidden One, and Right Leg of the Forbidden One—are Limited to 1 copy and remain in the Deck to satisfy Millennium Ankh while preserving the instant-win condition if drawn. The Legendary Exodia Incarnate is unaffected by other cards' effects and recovers a Forbidden One piece from the GY every End Phase, while two copies of Break the Seal can be sent from the field to search a Forbidden One piece (and bounce opposing cards per piece in your hand if destroyed).

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, gains ATK equal to your LP during damage calculation, negates 1 Spell/Trap activation every turn for free, and Sets an Exodd or Obliterate!!! Spell/Trap from the Deck every End Phase (at the cost of losing 1000 LP each Standby Phase).

Exxod Fires of Rage (Set from the Deck by Incarnate) destroys all cards your opponent controls at Quick-Play speed while you control a Level 10 or higher Exodia monster, and banishes itself from the GY to add a Forbidden One monster from the Deck or GY or shuffle them back.
Note: Activating Millennium Ankh prevents you from summoning monsters for the rest of that turn, so resolve your Millennium summons before playing Ankh.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Obliterate!!! Blaze pays half your LP to destroy all Spells and Traps on the field, then equips a Level 10 Exodia monster with the five Forbidden One pieces from your hand or Deck to grant it 10,000 ATK and piercing battle damage.
Obliterate!!! sends a Forbidden One or Exodia monster from the hand or Deck to the GY to bounce a monster on the field, and recovers a piece if sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The standalone Millennium cards built around Fiend Reflection of the Millennium and Heart of the Blue-Eyes belong to the dedicated Millennium decklist rather than Pure Exodia.

allow.Millennium Ankh: The Millennium Spell that summons The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate.

allow.Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasur: Makes Millennium Ankh unnegatable and searches Wedju Temple.
allow.Wedju Temple: Places the Millennium monsters from the Deck.
